name: I'm a Nurse Superpower Mug, Light Blue (18 oz)
seoTitle: I'm a Nurse Superpower Coffee Mug Gift
metaDescription: A light blue 18 oz mug that calls being a nurse a superpower. A cheerful, budget friendly pick for coworkers, new grads, and the nurse who runs on coffee.
summary: A big, cheerful mug that tells a nurse what everyone around them already knows: the job takes a kind of superpower.
whyItWorks: Coffee is practically part of the uniform for a lot of nurses. Before a 12 hour shift, during a rare charting break, or after a night shift when sleep has to wait, there is usually a mug in the picture. An 18 oz size leaves room for a proper refill, which matters when trips to the break room are few and far between.

The message is the real gift here. Nurses hear a lot of "thank you" in passing, but a mug that sits on the kitchen counter or the desk at the nurses station keeps saying it every morning. The light blue color is soft and easy to like, and the sentiment works for almost any specialty, from med surg to the ER. It is also an easy, low pressure gift for a coworker you know well enough to appreciate but not well enough to shop for in depth. Tuck in a bag of good coffee beans or a few tea packets and it becomes a complete little present.
goodToKnow: Check the listing for whether it is microwave and dishwasher safe before gifting to someone who reheats coffee often.
An 18 oz mug is larger than a standard cup, so it may not fit under every single serve coffee maker.
Pair it with coffee, tea, or a gift card to the hospital coffee cart.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a nursing student?
faq.a: Yes. The superpower message lands just as well with a student heading into clinicals, and a big mug is handy for long study nights.

faq.q: Will it work for a group gift?
faq.a: It is budget friendly enough to buy several for a small unit or a nurse preceptor group, though everyone will get the same design.
